items.title: وثائق شركة صندوق استثمار المصريين للاستثمار العقارى (EGREF.CA) - بيان بخصوص قيمة الوثيقة
items.title_en: Egyptians Real Estate Investment Fund Company Certificates (EGREF.CA) - Statement regarding the certificate value
items.meaning: A statement to the exchange that does not fall into one of the standard categories. What it says is in the filing.
